intended_object: An auxiliary sheafed space: the cone point of a cone of topological spaces, carrying the cocone-point sheaf of a cocone of inverse-image sheaves. It is used as the vertex when rebuilding a cone of sheafed spaces from such a cocone (from the docstring and the module documentation).
explanation: The definition only puts the given data together: carrier := c.pt, presheaf := K.pt.1, IsSheaf := K.pt.2. It is an intermediate construction for the proof (the vertex of the cone built next by `pullbackCoconeLeg`), not a standard mathematical notion. It does what its docstring says.
